Big Blue’s defense gave the Bucs trouble all night. item.title: Mimi Lee Scores 34 to Lead Notre Dame Over Tyner 66-53
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) Notre Dame sophomore Mimi Lee put on a show in the Best of Preps championship game on Monday night against Tyner. She poured in 34 points to lead the Irish to a 66-53 victory. Lee was named the tournament MVP. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
